dependencies.title: Extreme gaps between eigenvalues of random matrices
dependencies.pinned_version: Annals of Probability 41 (2013), 2648–2681; author-hosted published PDF
dependencies.mapping: For Haar CUE(N), consecutive circular eigenangle gaps scaled by N^(4/3), with angular location in an interior arc, converge to a marked Poisson process. Integrating over angle gives gap intensity u^2 du/(24 pi). Seam and all-pair singular-tail reductions are proved separately in the project; no theorem about the fixed deterministic map is supplied by this source.

dependencies.title: Loop Equations Characterize Random Matrix Statistics
dependencies.mapping: Used only for the loop-hierarchy characterization/convergence implication. The approximate mixed loop equations for the maintained deterministic model remain a project hypothesis.

dependencies.title: Universally optimal distribution of points on spheres
dependencies.mapping: For N>=2 the regular N-gon on S^1 is a sharp configuration (N=1 is immediate). Theorem 1.2 minimizes pair energy for completely monotone functions of squared chord distance; the project potential f_q(r)=(1-q^2)/((1-q)^2+qr) meets this hypothesis. Continuity extends the inequality to spectral multisets with repeated phases.

dependencies.title: Solutions of polynomial equation over F_p and new bounds of additive energy
dependencies.mapping: Applied to the displayed absolutely irreducible subgroup curve after the project's degree and size-range checks.

dependencies.title: Some cases of Vojta's conjecture on integral points over function fields
dependencies.mapping: Applied to the smooth Cayley curve after explicit degree, boundary, separability, and translated-subtorus checks.

dependencies.title: Algebraic trace functions over the primes
dependencies.mapping: The project reproduces the proof on the common good open to handle moving bad points; no stronger black-box statement is assumed.

dependencies.title: Torsion points on elliptic curves over function fields and a theorem of Igusa
dependencies.mapping: Supplies arithmetic openness/irreducibility input in the corrected elliptic off/off route after project-specific non-isotriviality and singular-support checks.

dependencies.title: Analytic Number Theory
dependencies.mapping: Used only for the stated dyadic averaged split-design prime-counting arguments; no pointwise PNT for a varying modulus is assumed.

dependencies.title: Chapter 4: Transcendence results
dependencies.locator: Theorem 4.8 and Corollary 4.9(i), printed page 48, PDF page 4
dependencies.mapping: For two distinct algebraic exponents 0 and i tau N(lambda-mu), coefficients -1 and 1, exponentials cannot coincide. This gives qualitative injectivity only, no spectral gap. The underlying single-chain representation was already recorded in supplement/fixed_map/weighted-secular/attempt.md.

dependencies.title: Characteristic Lyapunov exponents and smooth ergodic theory
dependencies.mapping: Smooth normalized area invariant under analytic G_kappa has entropy equal to its positive Lyapunov exponent, the integral of log unstable expansion; together with the Ruelle inequality this identifies P(-phi)=0.

dependencies.title: An inequality for the entropy of differentiable maps
dependencies.identifier: Boletim da Sociedade Brasileira de Matematica 9 (1978), 83-87; https://www.ihes.fr/~ruelle/PUBLICATIONS/%5B51%5D.pdf
dependencies.mapping: For every invariant probability on the smooth area-preserving Anosov two-torus, entropy is at most the integral of the one-dimensional unstable potential; hence P(-phi)<=0.

dependencies.title: Zeta functions and the periodic orbit structure of hyperbolic dynamics
dependencies.locator: Appendix III Markov partitions, Theorem 2.2 (PDF p. 25), Proposition 3.2 and Theorem 3.5 (pp. 41, 46), Propositions 4.7, 4.11, 4.12 (pp. 61, 65-66)
dependencies.mapping: Markov coding and Gibbs cylinder estimates yield the weighted two-endpoint pressure exponent; uniqueness and mixing identify equilibrium measures, strict convexity from nonconstant periodic unstable multipliers gives P(phi)>2h_top, analyticity and Hessian identify the perturbative variance. Endpoint comparison and kick coefficient are derived in the project rather than quoted as standalone external theorems.

dependencies.title: A simple and self-contained proof for the Lindemann-Weierstrass theorem
dependencies.locator: Theorem 3.2 (the linear independence of exponentials of distinct algebraic exponents over all algebraic coefficients)
dependencies.mapping: For nonzero real algebraic time t, collected finite exponential polynomials with real algebraic frequencies vanish at t exactly when identically zero; used with a separate imaginary-time nonvanishing witness for discriminants, resultants and fixed-model traces. The theorem gives no quantitative lower bound. The algebraic-entry antiunitary corollary uses the same input.

dependencies.title: Une version effective du théorème de Lindemann-Weierstrass par des méthodes d'indépendance algébrique
dependencies.mapping: Applied to a Q-independent integral-trace basis of exponent frequencies and the explicit integer norm of a frozen spectral discriminant. It gives an astronomically small gap bound only at odd 7-not-dividing-N and no trace cancellation.

dependencies.title: Some exact correlations in the Dyson Brownian motion model for transitions to the CUE
dependencies.mapping: Prior circular Dyson clock kernel. Project rederives odd-N normalization and an explicit uniform bound, then applies its quadratic-noise comparison. No novelty for Dyson clock relaxation.

dependencies.title: Semi-classical formula beyond the Ehrenfest time in quantum chaos. (I) Trace formula
dependencies.mapping: Conditional plane fixed-time input. Even-N torus theorem is not directly applicable to odd project dimensions. Exact parity repair is recorded; full source-to-model identification remains conditional.

dependencies.title: Fractal uncertainty for discrete two-dimensional Cantor sets
dependencies.locator: Theorem 2, printed p. 3; sharpness in Section 5.2 inspected, even-base failure derived internally
dependencies.mapping: Both alphabets equal A_M={(r,s):r!=s}; both iterates have side N=M^k and unitary 2D Fourier normalization 1/N. Project geometry excludes orthogonal full affine torus lines for odd M, and derives exact norm 1 at every scale internally for even M>=4 by an explicit supported unit vector. Binary norm is derived internally. Ideal digit model only; no actual doubled-map FUP or nonlinear coordinate-distortion hypothesis is supplied.

dependencies.title: Images of eigenvalue distributions under power maps
dependencies.identifier: arXiv:math/0008079; Probability Theory and Related Fields 125 (2003), 522–538
dependencies.mapping: For Haar V in U(n), eigenvalues of V^d are the union of d independent Haar spectra of sizes ceil((n-i)/d), 0<=i<d. Project n=p and power d=d_p. Used only for the correct reference block law; not needed for the elementary sector criterion and gives no deterministic block independence or cancellation.

dependencies.title: Linear functionals of eigenvalues of random matrices
dependencies.pinned_version: Author-hosted Berkeley tech-report 577, 19-page PDF; retrieved 30 September 2026
dependencies.mapping: Exact Haar-CUE joint trace moments equal Gaussian moments when both weighted degrees are <=N. All sixth, cubic/pair cross and pair/pair moments in the low-band arbitrary-weight variance have degree <=4 max I<=N. No arbitrary-Heisenberg Gaussian independence or deterministic-map theorem follows.
